title: Add file storage module for managing content

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for file metadata operations
acceptanceCriteria: useFileMetadataList fetches and caches the user's file metadata list
Mutation hooks invalidate relevant queries on success
Hooks use the actor returned by useActor and follow the error-handling pattern of existing hooks

file_operations.description: Add useFileMetadataList query hook to fetch file metadata using actor.listFileMetadata(). Add useCreateFileMutation, useUpdateFileMutation, and useDeleteFileMutation hooks that call actor.createFileMetadata, actor.updateFileMetadata, and actor.deleteFileMetadata respectively. Each mutation hook should invalidate the 'fileMetadata' query key on success. Follow the existing patterns for error handling, toast notifications, and query invalidation used by other entity hooks in this file.

requirements.summary: Create Files page displaying file metadata list with actions and wire into router
acceptanceCriteria: Files page renders a searchable/filterable list of file metadata using useFileMetadataList
Each file row shows filename, content type, size (formatted), and upload timestamp
Action buttons trigger appropriate dialogs or download flows
Page uses Persian (fa) labels from frontend/src/lib/fa.ts
FilesPage is accessible via /files route and protected by AuthGate

file_operations.description: Create a new FilesPage component that uses useFileMetadataList hook to fetch and display file metadata. Render a table or card list showing filename, contentType, size (formatted in KB/MB), and uploadedAt timestamp. Include a search input to filter files by filename. Add action buttons for each file: view/download (using REQ-23), edit metadata (opening FileMetadataEditDialog from REQ-24), and delete (with confirmation). Include a floating action button or header button to open the FileUploadDialog from REQ-22. Use Persian labels from fa.ts throughout. Follow the layout and styling patterns of WorkInboxPage.tsx and NotesPage.tsx.

Import FilesPage from './pages/FilesPage'. Add a new route for '/files' path that renders FilesPage wrapped in AuthGate. Position it in the Routes alongside existing page routes (DashboardPage, WorkInboxPage, TasksTodayPage, PlannerPage, NotesPage, SettingsPage, OnboardingWizardPage). Ensure the route is protected by authentication checks.

requirements.summary: Add file upload dialog with drag-and-drop support
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog allows selecting a file via input or drag-and-drop
Shows file preview (name, size, type) before upload
Displays upload progress or spinner during mutation
Closes and refreshes the file list on successful upload
Shows error toast on upload failure

file_operations.description: Create FileUploadDialog component accepting open/onOpenChange props. Implement a file input with drag-and-drop support (use onDragOver, onDrop events). Display selected file preview showing name, size, and type before upload. Include an optional notes/tags textarea. On submit, read the file as Uint8Array, construct a FileMetadata object (generate id, set owner to current principal, capture file properties, set uploadedAt to current timestamp), then call useCreateFileMutation with the metadata. Use ExternalBlob.fromBytes for the file content and call actor.createFileMetadata. Show a progress spinner during upload. On success, close dialog and show success toast. On error, display error toast. Use Persian labels from fa.ts. Follow the dialog pattern of NoteFormDialog.tsx and TaskFormDialog.tsx. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

acceptanceCriteria: Download action calls backend download method and converts Blob to browser download
Downloaded file uses the original filename and MIME type
Shows loading indicator during download
Handles download errors with user-visible messages

file_operations.description: Add a useDownloadFileMutation hook that accepts a file ID and FileMetadata. The mutation function should call a backend method to retrieve the file content (if one exists, otherwise use ExternalBlob methods to fetch bytes), create a Blob with the correct contentType, generate a download URL using URL.createObjectURL, create a temporary anchor element, set its href to the blob URL and download attribute to the fileName, trigger a click, then revoke the object URL. Show a loading toast during download and success/error toasts afterward. Use the actor from useActor. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog pre-fills current filename and notes
Saves changes via useUpdateFileMutation
Refreshes file list on success
Shows validation and error feedback

file_operations.description: Create FileMetadataEditDialog component accepting open, onOpenChange, and fileMetadata props. Pre-fill a form with fileName and notes fields from the provided fileMetadata. On submit, call useUpdateFileMutation with the file id and updated metadata object. Close dialog on success and show success toast. Display validation errors for empty fileName. Use Persian labels from fa.ts. Follow the form dialog pattern of ChannelProfileFormDialog.tsx.

requirements.summary: Add Files navigation item to AppShell sidebar
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation item appears in the sidebar between existing items
Icon is a file or folder icon (e.g., lucide-react FileText or Folder)
Label uses Persian translation from fa.ts
Clicking navigates to /files route

file_operations.description: Add a new navigation item for Files in the sidebar navigation array. Use FileText or Folder icon from lucide-react. Set the link to '/files' and use the Persian label from fa.ts (add 'files' key if needed). Position it between existing nav items (e.g., after Notes or before Settings). Follow the existing nav item structure.

requirements.summary: Update Dashboard to show file count card
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard fetches file metadata count via useFileMetadataList
Displays count in a card with a file icon and Persian label
Card links to /files page when clicked
Follows styling of existing dashboard cards

file_operations.description: Import and use useFileMetadataList hook to fetch file metadata. Add a new dashboard card displaying the count of files (fileMetadata.length). Use a FileText or Folder icon from lucide-react. Apply Persian label from fa.ts. Make the card clickable and navigate to '/files' on click. Position the card in the grid alongside existing cards for inbox, tasks, content plans, and notes. Follow the styling and structure of existing dashboard cards.

requirements.summary: Include file metadata in data export/import functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Export JSON includes file metadata records under a 'files' key
Import process restores file metadata records if present in the JSON
File content (binary data) is not included in export/import (only metadata)
Shows appropriate success/error feedback during import

file_operations.description: Update the export functionality to include fileMetadata from useFileMetadataList in the exported JSON under a 'fileMetadata' key (matching the ExportData structure from backend.d.ts). Update the import functionality to check for fileMetadata in the imported JSON and call useCreateFileMutation for each file metadata record (without binary content). Show progress feedback during import and success/error toasts. Ensure the exported JSON structure matches the ExportData type from backend interface (fileMetadata field already exists).

requirements.summary: Add Persian translations for file-related UI text
acceptanceCriteria: All new file UI strings have corresponding fa.ts entries
Translations are idiomatic Persian and consistent with existing app language
Keys follow the existing structure (e.g., files.upload, files.download)

file_operations.description: Add a new 'files' section to the fa translation object with keys for all file-related UI text: navigation label ('files'), page title, upload button, download action, edit action, delete action, file name label, content type label, size label, upload date label, notes/tags label, upload dialog title, upload success/error messages, download success/error messages, edit dialog title, delete confirmation message, and any other labels needed by FilesPage, FileUploadDialog, and FileMetadataEditDialog. Use idiomatic Persian translations consistent with existing app terminology. Follow the nested structure pattern used for other sections (e.g., workInbox, tasks, notes).
